chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Comedians on his shows
summary: He recalls Pig Meat Markham and Dusty Fletcher.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. We had fun. Shows like, when I had Pig Meat Markham. I used to do certain acts with them. I wouldn't miss standing on the side of the curtain just listening to those comedians perform.
If you'd just finish that sentence where you were talking about, what, Pig Meat, then we'll stop cause we don't want to get you too close.
Right. When I, Pig Meat Markham with his act, Vivian Harris (inaudible). They had a beautiful act. Here Come The Judge. I used to just get in that wing and sit there

and listen at them do that cause I had a lot of fun with them. I always had to have some kind of comedy on my show cause I liked to sit up there and enjoy myself too while the show was going on. Every show I had some kind of comedy. Dusty Fletcher, "Open The Door, Richard". Remember the time?
We was at, Dusty Fletcher was at the Strand with me, one of my engagements at the Strand. "Open The Door, Richard". We had a lot of fun. So, I really enjoyed it.
